title: Edge middleware and gate pages
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.
build: src/lib/auth/verify-token-edge.ts: verify the Firebase ID token from the __session cookie with jose createRemoteJWKSet (Google securetoken JWKS), issuer https://securetoken.google.com/<projectId>, audience <projectId>; return claims or null.

src/lib/auth/route-gate.ts (pure): decideRoute(claims|null, pathname) -> 'allow' | {redirect}. Order: no token -> /login; registered !== true -> /not-registered; profileComplete false and activeRole !== student -> /complete-profile; role-based access per nav.ts (e.g. students cannot open /rubrics; supervisors cannot open /students or /admin/staff-whitelist, which are coordinator/admin only per D-05). Public: /login, /not-registered, /api/session, static assets.
src/middleware.ts uses the two functions above with a matcher excluding _next and static files; no firebase-admin, no Firestore.

/not-registered page: unclosable (no nav), shows attempted email, category message (student vs staff, passed via query/session), coordinator contact from NEXT_PUBLIC_COORDINATOR_EMAIL, and a sign-out button.
Unit tests for decideRoute covering every redirect and every role/route pair.
rules: Middleware is a UX guard only; Firestore rules and Server Actions remain the enforcement layer
acceptance: Unauthenticated users hit /login; registered:false users are locked to /not-registered
decideRoute redirects a supervisor away from /students and /admin/staff-whitelist
